reason: With only the QA Claude idle-release timeout set to 0, the required turn failed to start on two successive runner attempts: Relay observed done 2 and applied retryable nacks, and the browser reported a runner-start failure. The twelve-minute zero-idle retention observation was never reached. Cursor was deferred by the tester, so no conclusion about Cursor zero-idle behavior is possible. The exact cause of exit status 2 is unverified without worker-log evidence.
observations: The isolated overlay changed only qa-claude idle_release_timeout from 10m to 0; qa-cursor remained 10m. One benign Claude prompt was submitted in the confirmed QA environment, with Enter bounded between 01:21:01.37 and 01:21:08.27 UTC rather than assigned a fictional exact submission time.

Two successive automatically created QA Claude workspaces handed off runners, then Relay observed done 2 and applied retryable nacks under zero idle. The browser reported it could not start a runner. This contradicts the prerequisite to complete a healthy turn and observe its idle retention; the twelve-minute zero-idle observation was not performed. The setting correlates with the failures, but their underlying CLI or worker cause is not established.

After the original QA config was restored byte-for-byte, an automatic retry for the same Claude browser session built a third workspace and returned a normal reply, observed between 01:24:01.614 and 01:24:09.110 UTC. That restored-baseline workspace remained running through 01:34:10, then exited cleanly and was naturally deleted. This baseline success does not establish a zero-idle pass.

The tester deferred Cursor. No Cursor prompt, manual workspace deletion, provider fault mode or twelve-minute zero-idle retention check occurred. No secret values, private logs or screenshots are included in this public result.
